description.value: Poseidon Restaurant & Bar is an authentic Greek and Mediterranean restaurant in Langley, BC, with a special emphasis on daily-caught seafood and dishes prepared on a charcoal brazier. The 90-seat dining room offers a modern, contemporary setting for experiencing traditional Greek cuisine and hospitality. The restaurant also caters to private functions including group bookings, weddings, and corporate events.

address.value: Unit 5 - 20811 Fraser Highway, Langley, BC V3A 4G7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the restaurant is a real, operating Greek/Mediterranean restaurant at Unit 5 – 20811 Fraser Hwy, Langley. The phone number 604-534-3900 appears on the gift card page, matching the OSM tag. The site confirms online ordering ('Order Online' links present), but contains no mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or most other amenity criteria. The website also contains injected spam content promoting online casinos and gambling sites, likely indicating a compromised CMS, though the core restaurant information remains consistent.
concerns: Website contains injected spam content promoting multiple online casino brands (Viggoslots, Gamblizard Canada, TrueLuck Casino, Slotlair Casino, Pino Casino, Starzino, Wild Robin Casino, Vipzino, Slot Monster, nelsonrosenvald.info) interspersed with legitimate restaurant content, strongly suggesting the CMS (WordPress) has been compromised or SEO-spammed. Core business information appears intact.
Terms & Conditions page contains the phrase 'hausarbeit ghostwriter kosten' — further evidence of spam/SEO injection into the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating sit-down restaurant with an active website, confirmed address, and online ordering. Useful stop for touring cyclists on Fraser Highway in Langley.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags indicate the restaurant accepts Bitcoin (Lightning Network and on-chain) and CoinOS payments, which may be of interest to some visitors. The website is built on WordPress (wp-admin detected) and appears to have been compromised.
